_comment: Caption vocabulary for the Guatemala UHI demo. Each concept is scored by encoding every caption with the alignment model's text branch, averaging, L2-normalising, and taking the dot product with a location's aligned embedding. Only concepts with a positive skill index on the test split are included - see heat_guatemala_concept_evaluation.csv.

vegetation_greenness.label: Vegetation greenness
captions: an area with high vegetation greenness
a location with lush green vegetation
a green area with healthy dense vegetation

forest_cover.label: Forest cover
captions: an area with dense forest cover
a heavily forested area with many trees

builtup_age.label: Established urban fabric
captions: an old urban area built many decades ago

cool_area.label: Cool area
cool_area._note: Optional. The model never saw temperature wording in training - aux_lst was deliberately excluded from the caption templates so the target could not leak. Cool areas are found indirectly, via their correlation with vegetation. Present it that way, not as temperature understanding.
captions: one of the coolest areas in the city
a location with low land surface temperature
a cool shaded part of the urban area

_excluded._note: These scored at or below baseline on the test split. They will still return confident-looking numbers, which is exactly why they must stay out of the demo vocabulary.
